results.name: Landmine Kneeling Alternating Overhead Press
instructions: Kneel tall on both knees facing the landmine, holding the end of the bar at one shoulder.
Press it up and forward until your arm is straight.
Lower it to your shoulder.
Switch hands and press with the other arm.
tips: Squeeze your glutes to keep your hips forward.
Keep the movement smooth.
results.description: Landmine Kneeling Alternating Overhead Press is a beginner multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Triceps, Core.

results.name: Landmine Kneeling Overhead Press
instructions: Kneel tall facing the landmine, holding the end of the bar at your chest with both hands.
Brace your core and squeeze your glutes.
Press the bar up and forward until your arms are straight.
Lower it to your chest and repeat.
tips: Don't arch your lower back.
Keep your elbows slightly in front of your body.
results.description: Landmine Kneeling Overhead Press is a beginner multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Triceps, Upper Chest, Core.

results.name: Landmine Lateral Raise
instructions: Stand side-on to the landmine and hold the end of the bar with the hand furthest from it, down by your hip.
Keep your arm almost straight.
Raise the bar out to the side up to shoulder height.
Lower it with control and repeat, then switch sides.
tips: Lead with your elbow.
Don't lean to lift the bar.
results.description: Landmine Lateral Raise is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Traps.

results.name: Landmine Overhead Press
instructions: Stand facing the landmine with the end of the bar held at your chest in both hands.
Brace your core.
Press the bar up and forward until your arms are straight.
Lower it to your chest and repeat.
tips: Keep your ribs down and your back neutral.
Push your head slightly forward at the top.
results.description: Landmine Overhead Press is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Triceps, Upper Chest.

results.name: Landmine Seated Alternating Overhead Press
instructions: Sit on a bench facing the landmine, holding the end of the bar at one shoulder.
Press the bar up and forward until your arm is straight.
Lower it to your shoulder.
Switch hands and press with the other arm.
tips: Sit tall with your feet planted.
Keep the bar path smooth.
results.description: Landmine Seated Alternating Overhead Press is a beginner multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Triceps, Core.

results.name: Landmine Seated Overhead Press
instructions: Sit on a bench facing the landmine, holding the end of the bar at your chest with both hands.
Brace your core with your back tall.
Press the bar up and forward until your arms are straight.
Lower it and repeat.
tips: Don't lean back.
Keep your feet planted.
results.description: Landmine Seated Overhead Press is a beginner multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Triceps, Upper Chest.

results.name: Landmine Seated Single Arm Overhead Press
instructions: Sit on a bench facing the landmine, holding the end of the bar at one shoulder.
Brace your core.
Press the bar up and forward with one arm until it is straight.
Lower it and repeat, then switch arms.
tips: Keep your torso square.
Control the lowering phase.
results.description: Landmine Seated Single Arm Overhead Press is a beginner multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Triceps, Core.

results.name: Landmine Single Arm Push Press
instructions: Stand facing the landmine, holding the end of the bar at one shoulder.
Dip slightly by bending your knees.
Drive up through your legs and press the bar up and forward until your arm is straight.
Lower it to your shoulder and repeat, then switch arms.
tips: Use the leg drive to move heavier weight.
Keep the dip short and upright.
results.description: Landmine Single Arm Push Press is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Triceps, Quadriceps, Core.

results.name: Landmine Single Arm Staggered Overhead Press
instructions: Stand in a staggered stance holding the end of the bar at the shoulder on the side of your back leg.
Brace your core.
Press the bar up and forward until your arm is straight.
Lower it and repeat, then switch sides.
tips: Keep your hips square.
Squeeze the glute of your back leg.
results.description: Landmine Single Arm Staggered Overhead Press is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Triceps, Core, Upper Chest.

results.name: Laying Lateral Raise
instructions: Lie on your side on a bench or the floor, holding a light weight in your top hand.
Start with your arm in front of your body.
Raise your arm up and out until it points toward the ceiling.
Lower it slowly and repeat, then switch sides.
tips: Use a light weight.
Keep a slight bend in your elbow.
results.description: Laying Lateral Raise is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Rear Shoulders.
